name: a district keeps four cleaners, two a day, and the Monday morning one goes round it in its uniform

steps.note: the district itself is the cleaners' workplace, four shifts of it: a morning and an evening for each of two groups on alternate days

arrival 84 of seed 7 is the first group's morning cleaner: Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday, seven to three. It is eight o'clock on the Monday, so it is on duty. Its needs are switched off so that nothing calls it away
with nothing to clean yet it walks round, its look over the district kept on the brains menu

steps.shot: the Monday morning cleaner going round the district in its teal coverall
